notes: No game type is named or implied — the author wants an empty, undecorated, baseplate-sized area to build on themselves — so this is No Genre, and the answers rule out reading any activity into it. Every axis sits at its default: a flat single-surface exterior, one zone, nothing that has to be structurally valid, and no volumetric play, which routes P0. This is the picked-nothing outcome the skill treats as legitimate, so there is no preset and no options: Open Sandbox was the nearest fit but its circulation paths and scattered pickups are exactly the decoration the author asked not to have, and adding boundary barriers or a landmark would furnish a place they want bare. With no user to ask I assumed the flat empty plate is the whole deliverable and that they will spawn and build on it themselves, so it is walkable and not a SET.
